review_method: Direct chronological inspection of all five every-frame task-view panels (25 columns, row-major), frames 0–2406, plus the larger 16-frame full-view montage. Each task thumbnail is 64x80 pixels from fixed crop x230:730 y80:690; robot, box and nearby terrain remain inside the crop. No temporal subsampling. Fine grasp/contact claims use independent 200 Hz forces and geometric traces; thumbnail review alone does not resolve small sliding.
observations: Physical ground acquisition and sustained lift.
Airborne retention through real alternating foot swings and replants; no gross grasp loss.
Slowing precedes smooth descent and ground transfer.
Physical opening, separated withdrawal and stable recovery.
grasp_review_note: Bounded compliant retention accepted, not zero slip: left/right material-point excursions 8.039/5.045 mm and relative palm rocking 8.961/6.860 degrees, with uninterrupted measured physical hand support.
